Cost: 3,000eb (Luxury) ♦ Install: Hospital

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)

A cybernetic upgrade to the heart that gives a second lease on life.

Internal Body Cyberware. Borgware. During combat, when the user first fails a death save, they may instead choose to either succeed or be automatically stabilized and fall unconscious for a a minute (20 Rounds). Either way, Second Heart is then considered damaged, requiring a DV17 surgery, 4 hours of labour, and 500eb of materials to repair before it can be used again.

NOTE: Credit to the From the Ashes LC for the idea on changes to this item.

Type: Internal Body Cyberware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • Counts as Borgware for Maximum Humanity Loss; the sheet doesn't track that, so apply it by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Internal Body Cyberware).
